title: Pixel Tag, Google's $30 Android-ready answer to Apple's AirTag, is now available | TechCrunch
summary: Google’s answer to Apple’s AirTag, the Google Pixel Tag , goes on sale starting Tuesday, allowing Android users to track items like their keys, wallet, or bag using their smartphone’s built-in Find Hub.
